crossRefs.note: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.
translations.bsb: That is why the LORD had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua.
translations.kjv: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
translations.asv: So Jehovah left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
